basis.value_representation: Unmodified DuckDB CAST AS VARCHAR; SQL NULL is JSON null. Keys use the unchanged historical L0 normalization.

edits.new: CAST(round(AVG(crashes) OVER(PARTITION BY package_name ORDER BY date_day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),2) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_7d_crashes
CAST(round(AVG(anrs) OVER(PARTITION BY package_name ORDER BY date_day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),2) AS DOUBLE) AS avg_7d_anrs
